description: Use when a user asks how to split a Christmas or holiday gift budget between people, how much to spend on each person, or what it costs to put gifts on a credit card, e.g. "split $800 for gifts between 5 people", "I have $600: Mom 30%, Dad 30%, my sister 40%", "is $150 for mom and $100 for dad within my $300 budget?" or "how much interest if I put $800 of gifts on a 22% card for 6 months?". Budget comes from total_budget, or monthly_income x percent_of_income, or already_saved + monthly_savings x months_until_shopping. Splits it evenly, by percent or by a set amount per person; returns each person's amount, the total, what is left or over budget and, with card_apr, the monthly payment and interest. Same math as the compoundmint.com Christmas gift budget calculator. For a whole holiday plan with travel, food and decor use calculate_holiday_budget. Educational only, not financial advice.

already_saved.description: USD already saved for gifts (savings route, default 0).

amount_on_card.description: Optional: USD put on the card (default: all planned gifts).

card_apr.description: Optional: credit card APR in percent, e.g. 22, to see the interest if the gifts go on a card.

monthly_income.description: Monthly take-home pay in USD, used with percent_of_income when there is no total_budget.

monthly_savings.description: USD you can save each month before you shop (savings route).

months_until_shopping.description: Months you can save before you shop (needed with monthly_savings).

number_of_people.description: Instead of people: how many people, for an even split.

payoff_months.description: Optional: months to pay the card off, e.g. 6. Without it you get 3, 6 and 12 months.

people.description: People on the gift list, up to 100. Each item: a name, plus percent (for a percent split) or amount in USD (for an amount split). Names alone give an even split. Text also works: "Mom:30%, Dad:30%, Sister:40%" (percents) or "Mom:150, Dad:100" (USD).

amount.description: Gift budget for this person in USD, e.g. 150.

name.description: Who the gift is for, e.g. Mom.

percent.description: Share of the budget in percent, e.g. 30.

per_person_budget.description: Instead of total_budget: USD to spend on each person, e.g. 50. The budget is this times the number of people.

percent_of_income.description: Percent of one month of take-home pay for gifts, e.g. 10 for 10%.

split.description: How to split the budget. Default: percent if people carry percents, amount if they carry amounts, else equal.

total_budget.description: Total gift budget in USD, e.g. 800. Or send per_person_budget with people or number_of_people, or monthly_income + percent_of_income, or monthly_savings + months_until_shopping.

name: calculate_gift_budget
title: Christmas gift budget calculator
